sections.content:
The conditional is the premier grammatical tool for offering advice. Two structures dominate Spanish conversation:

1. deberías + infinitive (you should)
2. Yo que tú / Yo en tu lugar + condicional (If I were you, I would...)

sections.title: Advice Formulas
rows: Deberías descansar un poco. (You should rest a bit.)
Yo que tú iría al médico. (If I were you, I'd see a doctor.)
Yo en tu lugar hablaría con él. (In your place, I'd speak to him.)
Sería mejor esperar hasta mañana. (It would be better to wait.)

items.spanish: Estás muy cansado, deberías dormir ocho horas.
items.english: You are very tired, you should sleep eight hours.

items.spanish: Yo que tú no compraría ese billete tan caro.
items.english: If I were you, I wouldn't buy such an expensive ticket.
